interface.name: ESA Indico public category/event export, static owner-page, and direct material routes
interface.access_route: anonymous public HTTP with redirects disabled; local browser used only for official-documentation discovery, not source traversal
interface.database_or_collection: focused public ESA Indico diagnostic route sample only
interface.timezone: timestamps retain explicit -04:00 offsets; source event times retain source timezone metadata

executions.purpose: Audit official exporter/category documentation and test bounded category-0 root/component, date-overlap, sentinel, and practical count/row/cap behavior
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous GET category exports: category 0 and categories 5/6 for 2023-11-01..2023-11-30; category 0 exact days 2023-11-16, 2023-11-17, 2023-11-18; candidate sentinel exact days 1900-01-01 and 2100-01-01; repeated category-0 2020-01-01..2024-12-31 cap probe
executions.notes: The 148-row cap probe reconciled internally and across two passes, but category-0 all-time recursion/cap behavior remains unproven. Sentinel zeros are bounded inputs, not source totals.

executions.purpose: Compare the documented subcontributions and sessions contribution inventories for one session-bearing event
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous GET /export/event/407.json?detail=subcontributions and /export/event/407.json?detail=sessions; compare stable contribution-ID sets only
executions.notes: The two detail routes had the same 62-ID contribution set. No non-empty nested record was observed.

executions.purpose: Complete one bounded event-specific public-PDF route including static-owner reconciliation, direct access, secure download/hash, deterministic text, OCR, and post-coverage local matching
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous event-472 detail=subcontributions export, static event page, all 15 contribution owner pages, no-redirect direct-material probes, every confirmed public PDF secure fetch/hash/pdftotext, mandated OCR for two empty parses, then dictionary-hash-locked local matching
executions.notes: 13 routes were confirmed public PDFs and terminally text/OCR covered; two static-only links were restricted/non-public. Matching emitted no candidate and no import. This is one bounded pass, not a final all-source two-pass result.

executions.purpose: Validate full owner-page enumeration plus public non-PDF queue and receipt failure behavior
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous event-407 detail=subcontributions export, static event page and all 62 contribution owner pages, no-redirect direct-material probes, content-free queue generation, and validator run on one unsupported public video receipt
executions.notes: All 28 public non-PDF videos remained queued; the intentionally unsupported receipt was correctly incomplete, proving no silent no-match. This event is not complete.

executions.purpose: Bounded export-shape search for nested and irregular/external material behavior, with per-event failure preservation
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous detail=subcontributions export-shape scans of eight November-2023-root-derived events and the first twelve stable IDs from the bounded 2020-2024 cap ledger
executions.notes: Nineteen event exports completed without a non-empty nested record or irregular/external route; event 321 failed closed on attachment-ID/title conflict. Neither absence is generalized to the source.

checks.requirement: Bounded root category count/row/order reconciliation and root/component comparison
checks.notes: Verified for named bounded windows only; current response complete flag was absent/null.

checks.requirement: All-public all-time category-0 recursion, sentinel, and cap proof
checks.notes: Official documentation does not establish the exporter semantics, and P03 bounded observations cannot prove all-time coverage.

checks.requirement: Current date-overlap behavior and candidate sentinels
checks.notes: Observed only for specified days and accepted bounded sentinel inputs; not a publication-date or all-time boundary rule.

checks.requirement: detail=subcontributions contribution coverage for a session-bearing event
checks.notes: Event 407 detail=subcontributions IDs equalled the sessions union; generalization remains limited.
No non-empty nested record was located in bounded successful scans; final operation remains failure closed.

checks.requirement: Every confirmed public PDF in one bounded event is separately access-probed, fetched, hashed, text-extracted/OCRed, and locally matched after coverage
checks.notes: Verified for 13 current event-472 public PDFs only; two restricted static-only links are explicit non-public dispositions.

checks.requirement: Public non-PDF is queued and an unsupported terminal state cannot become a no-match
checks.notes: The route was intentionally incomplete rather than silently dropped.
None appeared in bounded successful scans; queue behavior is code-tested but live source shape remains unobserved.

checks.requirement: Attachment identity conflict is preserved as a coverage failure
checks.notes: Conflicting title metadata for one attachment ID was recorded without a partial ledger.

checks.requirement: PDF-only candidate gate and dictionary-hash lock
checks.notes: P03 matching used the locked dictionary and terminal PDF/OCR routes; metadata/filenames are noncandidate diagnostic routes.

checks.requirement: No screening, eligibility assessment, final event, or candidate import
checks.notes: All P03 artifacts are diagnostic-only and candidate import is prohibited.

disposition.reason: P03 validates bounded root/date/cap behavior, a session-bearing contribution export, a complete event-specific public-PDF/OCR route, and failure-closed non-PDF/access/identity behavior. It cannot establish the all-public category-0 universe, a non-empty nested route, real irregular/external material routing, terminal non-PDF coverage, or a final two-pass census.
human_verification_required: Decide whether the bounded evidence and failure-closed draft are enough to accept the ESA method while retaining its final-run gates, or require the listed next experiments first.
Validate/authorize the all-public category-0 recursion, all-time sentinel, cap calibration, and final two-pass census design.
Review the PDF-only candidate gate and local normalization/field-boundary rules against the protocol.
Approve secure storage and provider handling for final PDF/OCR work; P03 storage was diagnostic only.
Set P-001 common evidence cutoff before any final event.
Review P01/P02 historical correction links and P03's event-321 identity failure; do not relabel old pilots or import any pilot record.
